summary: Told from the first perspective of Apollo 17’s Lunar roving vehicle (LRV-3), “ A longing,  at Taurus-Littrow” blends real NASA science mission history and lunar physics to trace LRV-3’s journey from its 1972 launch and Shorty Crater exploration with Eugene Cernan and Harrison Schmitt to waiting 54 years in the lunar night and being spotted by NASA’s Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter, Abandoned in the dust yet never forgotten.
details: "A Longing, at Taurus-Littrow"is a first-person narrative told from the perspective of Apollo 17's Lunar Roving Vehicle (LRV-3), resting silently in the Taurus-Littrow valley. Rather than a conventional textbook list of facts, it offers a poetic, soothing window into real NASA science and history inviting readers to experience the wonder, humanity, and legacy of the Apollo 17 mission through emotion rather than traditional study.used: Google Docs and canva only
